description: ECLS v1 saved-score evidence and numerical reanalysis package accompanying the antibody-peptide structural sequence-scoring manuscript. Primary frozen endpoint: 31 structures in 15 antigen clusters; mean native-versus-composition-shuffle ECLS advantage 0.172281, cluster-bootstrap 95% CI [0.059156, 0.291920], 12/15 positive clusters. Includes current manuscript, supplementary boundaries, portable saved results, provenance digests and numerical verification code. Machine-specific paths are normalized in derived copies; original frozen results are unchanged. Excludes historical contact-v2 model bundles, third-party weights, raw structural databases and the separate PAE manuscript. Reproduces saved-score statistics, not end-to-end inference or experimentally validated binding. Local preparation only: author declarations, license confirmation and remote DOI remain pending.
